adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces per-host category routing via `EmbeddableHost` (no DB foreign key / no `dependent:` behavior shown) and uses it during import: `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` then `category: eh.try(:category_id)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). If the category referenced by `embeddable_hosts.category_id` is later deleted, `eh` still exists but points to a non-existent category; the Ember UI also relies on `host.category` (`{{category-badge host.category}}` and `this.get('host.category.id')` in the component) which will be missing when hydration can’t find the category, leading to an empty badge and `categoryId` becoming null. On save, the controller forces blank `category_id` to `uncategorized_category_id` (embeddable_hosts_controller.rb), silently rewriting the dangling config. This creates incorrect/hidden behavior (embeds not landing in the intended category and admin UI not surfacing the misconfiguration) that is grounded in the new code paths.
